title: Recess-Bench Watchmaker Preparation
description: One static watchmaker preparation scene for the original timekeeping repair program. Three complete existing models at original scale and identity orientation: the full recess-front watchmaker bench, one complete empty three-pocket and twin-cradle parts tray on its rear-right workboard, and the original full fixed-open pocket watch separately on the left workboard arm. The existing watch is not disassembled, enlarged or fitted into the tray. Every original raw GLB POSITION/NORMAL/index buffer, internal node and per-face PBR is preserved. Both whole guest soles are covered by actual upward workboard triangles, with the original front recess kept empty and all other bench parts clear; the bench retains all four finite grounded feet and its separate lower catch tray. Only one connected floor and cutaway wall boundary are new scene geometry. This is a new bench preparation arrangement, not the old pendulum-clock and sundial display, and is counted as one scene and zero new independent models. Tiny watch markers are not promised readable in the whole-room view. No actual repair instruction, tool fit, parts retention, antistatic performance, magnification, timekeeping, calibration, gear motion, winding, cover motion, human ergonomics, load, manufacture, installation or occupational safety is claimed.
